comun.sin_periodos: No periods yet: they open with the farm's first accounting event.

col.valor_neto: Fair value less costs to sell

motivo.SIN_PRECIO: The species has no current market price.
motivo.SIN_MAGNITUD: The asset has no recorded weight or count.
motivo.SIN_COSTOS_VENTA: The species has no costs to sell configured.
motivo.VALOR_NETO_NO_POSITIVO: Costs to sell equal or exceed the fair value.

config.descripcion: Close frequency, how each species is measured, its costs to sell and the accounts for each accounting event.
config.tipo_cierre_ayuda: The change applies to periods opened from now on; open periods keep their frequency.
config.umbral_ayuda: A new price further than this from the current one asks for confirmation.
config.umbral_invalido: Enter a percentage greater than 0 and up to 1000.
config.especies_ayuda: Each species is measured per kilogram or per head. Costs to sell are the share of gross value it costs to sell the asset. Useful life is only used when the species has no market price.
config.clasificacion_requerida: Choose whether the species is bearer or consumable.
config.vida_invalida: Useful life must be a whole number of months.
config.matriz_ayuda: Pair of ledger accounts for each event. A mapping for a species or cost type overrides the general one.
config.matriz_vacia: No accounts mapped yet. Without them the close cannot produce the voucher.
config.cuentas_iguales: Debit and credit accounts must differ.
config.pendientes_detalle: Map the accounts for their event: the lines complete themselves and the close becomes available.

precios.descripcion: Reference prices per species with their source and evidence. A price is never edited: it is corrected by recording a new one.
precios.registrar_ayuda: Source priority is active market, then UPRA, and last the Accountant's documented estimate.
precios.corregir_ayuda: The correction is a new price that replaces the previous one from its effective date.
precios.vacio_detalle: Record each species' market price to recognize and measure its assets at fair value.
precios.sin_productos: The species has no active production metrics.
precios.precio_invalido: Enter a price greater than zero.
precios.fuente_ayuda: Use an estimate only when there is no active-market or UPRA price.
precios.vigencia_ayuda: A future date schedules the price.
precios.vencimiento_invalido: Expiry must be after the effective date.
precios.justificacion_ayuda: Why there is no market price and which comparables you used (at least 50 characters).
precios.justificacion_estimada: Document the estimate with at least 50 characters.
precios.desviacion_titulo: The price deviates a lot from the current one

recon.descripcion: Assets not yet in the books. The initial value is fair value less costs to sell; if the species has no price, it is measured at cost.
recon.vacio_detalle: Every registered asset already has its initial recognition.
recon.modal_ayuda: Review the calculation before confirming. The difference between initial value and acquisition cost goes to profit or loss for the period.
recon.sin_hechos: This recognition produces no gain or loss.
recon.costos_invalidos: Costs must be numbers equal to or greater than zero.
recon.justificacion: Justification and support for the costs
recon.justificacion_corta: Justify the asset-specific costs with at least 20 characters.

valor.descripcion: Carrying amount of each recognized asset. Each measurement separates the change from growth from the change from price.
valor.vacio_detalle: Confirm the assets' initial recognition to start measuring them.
valor.sin_titular: The farm has no tax holder
valor.simulacion_ayuda: This is only a query: it creates no entries and does not change the carrying amount.
valor.modelo_costo_ayuda: The asset is measured at cost because its species had no market price at recognition. Once a price exists it must move to fair value.
valor.cambio_ok: The asset is now measured at fair value.
valor.deterioro_ayuda: Impairment reduces the carrying amount because of a health event that affected the asset.
valor.evento_sanitario_ayuda: Number of the health event recorded in Biological assets.
valor.deterioro_incompleto: Enter the health event, an impact greater than zero and a justification of at least 30 characters.
valor.mediciones_ayuda: The total change is split into the biological transformation part and the market price part.
valor.sin_lineas: The asset has no entry lines.
valor.revertir_ayuda: Posts the mirror entry. Only possible if the asset has no later measurements or costs.

costos.descripcion: Labor, services and purchases attributable to the assets. Feed and medicine consumption arrive automatically from Supplies.
costos.registrar_ayuda: A maintenance cost is a period expense. An investment is only capitalized on assets measured at cost.
costos.vacio_detalle: Record here the costs that do not come from Supplies.
costos.clasificar_ayuda: State the cost's nature and why: it decides whether it is an expense, an investment or a cost to sell.
costos.naturaleza_ayuda: Leave as is unless the cost is an investment or a cost to sell.
costos.capitalizar_ayuda: Only for assets measured at cost; on a fair-value asset the investment is an expense.
costos.aviso_fuente_unica: This invoice reaches the books through the SIGAB export: do not enter it manually in the accounting system.
costos.monto_invalido: Enter an amount greater than zero.
costos.reparto_minimo: Choose at least two assets to allocate the cost.
costos.justificacion_requerida: This cost requires a justification of at least 10 characters.
costos.proveedor_incompleto: Fill in the tax ID (6 to 15 digits), check digit, legal name, invoice number and date.

cierre.descripcion: The close measures the assets with the last day's prices, consolidates the IAS 41 voucher and produces the income statement and the draft disclosures.
cierre.vacio_detalle: Periods open with the first accounting event of each tax holder.
cierre.ultimo_fallido: The last close attempt failed at step {{paso}}
cierre.listo: The period is ready to close.
cierre.sin_precio_one: {{count}} asset without a current market price
cierre.sin_precio_other: {{count}} assets without a current market price
cierre.sin_trazabilidad_one: {{count}} line with an incomplete traceability chain
cierre.sin_trazabilidad_other: {{count}} lines with an incomplete traceability chain
cierre.excluir: Exclude them from this close's remeasurement
cierre.incluir_estimacion: Measure them with the last known price, flagged as an estimate
cierre.autorizar_lineas: I authorize excluding lines with incomplete traceability from the voucher (they move to the next period)
cierre.confirmar_detalle: You are about to close {{periodo}}. The period becomes immutable: events dated in it that arrive later are recorded in the next one.
cierre.siguiente_abierto: The next period has been opened.
cierre.sin_comprobantes: The close produced no vouchers (there were no accounting events).
cierre.comprobantes_al_cerrar: Vouchers are generated when the period closes.
cierre.lineas_ayuda: Each line must trace back to its evidence: the event, reading or price that originated it.
cierre.sin_lineas: The period has no entry lines.
cierre.ver_cadena_aria: View the traceability chain of line {{id}}

cot.descripcion: Sale offers for assets with their reference fair value at quoting time.
cot.sin_efecto: Quotes have no accounting effect: they do not change asset values or create entries.
cot.vacio_detalle: Record a quote to compare the offered value with the fair value.
cot.valor_invalido: Enter a value greater than zero.
cot.justificacion_requerida: Justify the change with at least 10 characters.

er.descripcion: Gains and losses on biological assets for the period, with maintenance costs as expenses.
er.vacio_detalle: It is produced when the period closes, or you can generate it now to review it.
er.descarga_aprobado: Download becomes available once the statement is approved.
er.excluidos_detalle_one: {{count}} asset was excluded from remeasurement for lack of a price.
er.excluidos_detalle_other: {{count}} assets were excluded from remeasurement for lack of a price.

rev.descripcion: Disclosures for the closed period: reconciliation, split of gains, methods, commitments and risks.
rev.vacio_detalle: The close creates the first draft version.
rev.rechazar_ayuda: State what needs to be corrected. You can then generate a new version.
rev.generar_ayuda: Record the period's commitments and pledged assets, or declare there are none.
rev.sin_novedad: I declare there are no commitments or pledged assets in the period.
rev.justificacion_ayuda: Required if the system detects differences between sources (at least 20 characters).
rev.filas_incompletas: Fill in each commitment's description and each pledge's asset and lender.
rev.declare_o_registre: Record at least one commitment or pledge, or tick the declaration.
rev.datos_insuficientes: Not enough data for this section.

s.parr_40_ganancias_perdidas: Gain or loss for the period (¶40)
s.parr_51_separacion_precio_transformacion: Split between price and biological transformation (¶51)

aud.descripcion: Every operation in the module with its author, the amount affected and its integrity fingerprint.
aud.vacio_detalle: There are no audit events for the chosen period and filters.

evento.RECONOCIMIENTO_BLOQUEADO_SIN_VALOR: Recognition blocked: no price or cost
evento.MEDICION_SIN_VARIACION: Measurement with no change in value
evento.ACTIVO_MARCADO_SIN_MERCADO: Asset without market price: cost model
